facts.fact: SierraLoaded reports that Sierra Leone's National Cybersecurity Coordination Centre (NC3) acts through the national computer security incident response team, SL-CSIRT.
NC3, through SL-CSIRT, issued a critical alert reported on 24 October 2026 on two PHP remote-code-execution flaws (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, severity 9.2).
